services.name: Summer Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Unwind on our Summer Sunset Cruise, a relaxing evening on the beautiful waters surrounding Orcas Island. As the sun sets over the San Juan Islands, enjoy a selection of light appetizers, snacks, and dessert while taking in the spectacular scenery. Complimentary non-alcoholic beverages are included, and beer, wine, cider, and cocktails are available for purchase onboard. It's the perfect way to slow down, soak in the views, and experience a Pacific Northwest sunset from the water. Light snacks & appetizers are provided, but you’re welcome to bring other food & non-alcoholic drinks. Alcoholic drinks must be purchased onbaord. services.name: Whale Watching Trips
services.desc: Since 1988, we’ve offered small-group, educational wildlife tours that showcase the full marine ecosystem of the San Juan Islands. Family-friendly and respectful of wildlife, every trip is led by a passionate local crew and designed to be both meaningful and memorable. Create memories that last a lifetime. Both morning and afternoon tours are great options for whale watching around Orcas Island. Unlike much of the West Coast, we don’t typically experience a strong afternoon wind increase, so sea conditions are often favorable throughout the day.
